name: Plainstead
descriptionSeed: Plainstead — arbitration, assay and record: where a dispute goes when both sides want it settled and neither wants blood. Boring on purpose. The Stark Reach will strip you to the truth; Plainstead will just tell you who owns the field.
encounterFlavor: traders, apprentices and people from three domains who have learned to share a street
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180). ⚠️ Every component is |0.45| or less by construction: a foothill is not extreme on any axis, which is what distinguishes it from its pole capital.
worldPosNote: ⚠️ THE LITERAL MIDPOINT between the Crossing and the_unblinking_stone, taking the short way round on longitude. The world position states the philosophy: a foothill sits half the distance out from the centre toward its pole, and the geography and the fiction say the same thing.
